# Tavlo Studio

> Tavlo Studio (formerly Nexora Tech) is a website, product and branding design studio founded in 2021 by Afolabi Oluwaseyi Christopher in Ado Ekiti, Nigeria. It serves clients worldwide, remotely.

## Services
- [Website Design](https://tavlostudio.github.io/#/service/website): custom, fast, mobile-friendly websites
- [Shopify Development](https://tavlostudio.github.io/#/service/shopify): Shopify stores built for conversion
- [UI/UX & Product Design](https://tavlostudio.github.io/#/service/product-design): interfaces for web and apps
- [Branding Design](https://tavlostudio.github.io/#/service/branding): logos and brand identities
- [AI-Powered Websites](https://tavlostudio.github.io/#/service/ai): websites with built-in AI chat and automation
- [SEO, GEO & AEO](https://tavlostudio.github.io/#/service/search): search, generative and answer-engine optimization (custom quote)

## Key facts
- Pricing: websites from $499 (Starter), $999 (Growth), $1,999+ (Premium)
- Delivery: 7–14 days for websites, 5–10 days for Shopify stores
- Support: 30 days of free post-launch support
- Contact: [nexoratech221@gmail.com](mailto:nexoratech221@gmail.com) or [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/2349068643075)
